data.value: Charging estimate is experimental and can change with temperature, workload and the adapter.

data.name: CollectingDetail
data.value: Keep using the PC on battery for a few minutes: the first estimate comes from recent use.

data.name: ContextHelp
data.value: Aggregate CPU load/frequency, memory, battery watts, brightness, power profile and available temperatures. No process names or online telemetry. Missing sensors stay unavailable; ACPI zones are not CPU temperature. More data does not guarantee better accuracy.

data.name: CustomInvalid
data.value: Check HH:mm times, percentages and shortcut. No invalid changes were saved.

data.name: Demo

data.name: DemoCharging
data.value: Demo · synthetic charging example, not a measurement

data.name: DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Creates a local ZIP with versions, preferences and the model card. It excludes battery history and logs and is never uploaded automatically.

data.name: PrefLoginHelp
data.value: History is only recorded while Battery Forecast is running.

data.value: At most one alert per threshold per discharge; none on the adapter or with an old estimate. Do not disturb can hide them.

data.name: PrefNotifyTime
data.value: When about 60, 30 and 15 minutes are left to the reserve

data.name: PrefRefreshHelp
data.value: The model starts only to compute (about 3 s of CPU) and then closes. With battery saver on it never starts by itself; recent-use estimates keep working.

data.name: PrefReserveHelp
data.value: Estimates tell you when the battery reaches this level, not when the PC turns off.

data.name: PrefTargetHelp
